name: brief-agents
description: A subagent inherits none of your durable rules — not your CLAUDE.md, not your memory, not your installed-plugin nudges — so it can blindly violate one it never heard of. brief-agents scans all three layers into one compact ~/.claude/agent-briefing-index.md (auto-regenerated when the sources change) and nudges you to brief the subagent with it before delegating architecture or code work. A SessionStart hook nudges you, and a PreToolUse hook enforces at call time (blocks an unbriefed Agent/Task code delegation, soft-reminds for Workflow; add [no-brief] to opt out), plus a skill with the procedure. Sibling to no-hidden-changes, measure-twice, audit-loose-ends.
